ask: Move Tuesday's LinkedIn post to Thursday at 2pm.
before: list-workspace-posts (the scheduled queue, by account_ids) showed the post: Tue Nov 17, 9:07 am (New York), LinkedIn, "Most hiring advice…". The reply asked "Move it to Thu Nov 19, 2:00 pm (New York)?" and the user said yes.

steps.why: On a post already Scheduled, publish-post with a new when moves it: only the time changes. A time-only move keeps the post Scheduled with its approval and any client sign-off; the result says rescheduled: true. Wall clock in the brand's time zone, no Z, no offset; add timezone only if the user named a place. The new time must be in the future.
Read back the status and time Bolta stored, if the result didn't show them.

say: Moved for Acme: LinkedIn "Most hiring advice…" now goes out Thu Nov 19, 2:00 pm (New York). It keeps its approval.
never: Taking the post off the schedule (save-post with unschedule) just to change its time: that sends it back for a new yes.
Changing the text in the same turn: any edit to text, media or accounts needs a new yes.
Moving it before the user saw the new time and said yes.
Using save-post to move a post: it takes no time, and any edit sends the post back for review. publish-post with the new when is the move.
